AI, see what AI is doing to our water system:  Massive Electricity Demand: Training and running AI models requires enormous computing power. Data centers are consuming so much power that some fossil-fuel plants are being kept online longer than planned to meet the surge. By some estimates, global data center energy usage could reach 4% of annual global electricity.
High Water Consumption: Servers generate colossal amounts of heat and require vast volumes of freshwater for cooling towers to maintain optimal temperatures. Generating a single AI prompt or image can consume significant amounts of water and electricity.
